Four pages from the workbook. Which one would your kid grab first? 🖍️

The ADHD Fun Learning Workbook has 37 activity pages: mazes, spot the difference, find and circle, tracing, picture sudoku, connect the dots, odd one out, plus memory and pattern games. Each page is a short, hands-on activity, and the next one is something different.

It's screen-free quiet time for home, the classroom or homeschool. You get a print-ready PDF plus PNG and JPG files, 6 x 9 in pages, and you can print it as many times as you need.
